about: workflow:read-a-source-message-work: reads the exact Request, Task, execution claim and execution session of one source message from the person's own store, without changing them. It replaces workflow:read-source-message-work (action:read-source-message-work in tools/take-requests), whose four reads ran through the engine's read-current step on the records store. Nothing is kept, so only the reading is left and the store is spoken to directly.

payload.label: Read the work of one source message
payload.job: Read the Request, Task, execution claim and execution session of one source message (record_ref request:<source>:<native message>) from the person's own store, exactly as they are, and say which of the four are there.
payload.produces: The four rows as the store keeps them, or null for each one that is absent, read by the store's own objects. Nothing is written.

source.from: tools/take-requests things-to-store-and-run.json, action:read-source-message-work (four engine.operation.label-addressed read-current steps and a return), on trillion-workshop origin/main 662917e782.
source.note: The addresses are the ones the request-intake records keep: the Request at record_ref, the Task at entity|<record_ref> (label hash), the claim at <record_ref>:execution-claim and the session at <record_ref>:execution-session. The store is read directly; no tool sits between the reader and its rows.

where.description: Where the person keeps these rows: the store's own address

language.description: How that store is spoken to, in its own terms

credential_name.description: The vault name of the login the run uses, when it needs one

record_ref.description: The source message's record_ref, request:<source_ref>:<native message ref>

steps.title: Read the four rows
steps.do: Speak to the store in its own language, with the login under its credential_name. Read, without changing anything: the Request at record_ref; the Task whose id is record_ref (the task is kept under the label hash of entity|<record_ref>); the execution claim at <record_ref>:execution-claim; and the execution session at <record_ref>:execution-session. Each one read as it is kept, with its version. Submit each row's payload, or null when the store has no row there.

steps.title: Prove the reads on the example rows
steps.do: In a throwaway copy of the store with the same objects, seed the rows in store_before, then run each read of the look step on it and compare with expect. Run the attempts in order; every answer must be the one the intent says. payload.erase: On the person's request the store deletes the Request, Task, claim and session rows of the source message; this recipe keeps nothing, so it has nothing of its own to erase.
